page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.u2a server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor operating at a baseline clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance features 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this server type.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance offers a compute-leaning resource profile. It is qualitatively structured as a cost-efficient option for entry-level workloads that require dedicated CPU execution without high memory demands. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, microservices, small-scale application hosting, and basic development or testing environments.
